# Mounteko Global Solutions

Enterprise-grade cloud solutions, managed IT services, network architecture, and advanced cybersecurity for growing US businesses.

## Key Services
- Network Solutions: LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and remote access.
- Cybersecurity: Threat detection, SOC monitoring, VAPT, and endpoint security.
- Cloud & IT Infrastructure: AWS/Azure cloud migration, backup, and server management.
- Managed IT Services: 24/7 IT support, remote management, and SLA-based services.
- Software & Web Development: Website design, ecommerce, custom web apps, and API development.
- AI Integration & Automation: AI workflows, chatbots, sales automation, and analytics.
